meta.name: Crime Patrol 26 Jurm 26 Cases
meta.description: From disturbing murder cases to gripping investigations, follow police officers as they delve into the most violent crimes that plague society.

videos.title: Aakhri Call
videos.overview: Months after a young woman's death, five students receive calls from her number. But the case turns murky when a decapitated body is found on campus.

videos.title: Hotel Blood Stone
videos.overview: After being missing for 10 days, a woman appears in a disturbing viral video taken at Hotel Blood Stone. Will the police be able to track her down in time?

videos.title: Ek Kaatil, 15000 DNA
videos.overview: When a woman named Naina is found dead, police question people living in the housing complex. Soon a criminal web begins to unravel.

videos.title: 48 Ghante, Tukdo Mein Sach
videos.overview: The founder of Pro Life Insurance, Subodh Khanna, goes missing under mysterious circumstances. When his wife presents a suicide video to the police, questions arise.

videos.title: Garba Mein Maut
videos.overview: Amid the vibrant celebrations of Navratri in a small Gujarat town, a devoted mother sets out to prove her son's innocence when he is accused of murdering a young girl.

videos.title: Sard Murder
videos.overview: When Harshdeep Kochchar's (Harry) body is found in a freezer at his brother's restaurant, the investigation spirals into a web of lies, love, and betrayal.

videos.title: Mitti Mein Dafan Sach
videos.overview: When the wife and daughters of a distinguished judge vanish overnight, the evidence emerges in layers-one burial at a time-the case turns into a nightmarish puzzle full of deception, misdirection, and unsettling truths.

videos.title: Slimming Pill, Bloody Kills
videos.overview: Superstar Randhir Raii is kidnapped, and ACP has 24 hours to save him. As the investigation unfolds, it exposes a deadly pharma scandal and a grieving father's fight for justice.

videos.title: Ratna
videos.overview: Sanju arrives at his home to attend his sister Ratna's wedding ; only to see a sight that will shock him forever and suffer an attack that will handicap him forever. Sanju's whole family has been killed.

videos.title: Charu
videos.overview: A maid is dead. But her secrets lived on in the lives of those who thought they never knew her. Her shocking ties to multiple elite residents come to light.

videos.title: Shruti
videos.overview: When a young woman vanishes while delivering food, her search leads the cops into the hidden mysteries of the city's largest slum. Can the cops find out the terrible truth about the young girl?

videos.title: Salma
videos.overview: Salma , a cook at a street-food cart is found beaten and unconscious in an auto; on regaining consciousness , she says that she got into a fight with her ex-boyfriend who has fled.

videos.title: Roshni Behnaaz, Part 1
videos.overview: Set in the Parsi community, Roshni, a new mother is killed and the suspects are many - her husband, her maid, her neighbor amongst many others. Cops are not able to find the killer and now an expert is empanelled to investigate further.

videos.title: Roshni Behnaaz, Part 2
videos.overview: Behnaaz is Roshni's best friend. Her quest for finding Roshni's murder intensified. What complicated the case further is that she herself was a victim of domestic violence.

videos.title: Shagun
videos.overview: Shagun Sandhu disappears the morning after celebrating her 20th birthday, just hours after her father receives a threatening call. The next day, her body is discovered in a park. Who made the call, and why was Shagun targeted?

videos.title: Sujata
videos.overview: Newlyweds Ramesh and Sujata arrive in Mumbai to start a new life. But joy turns into dread when Ramesh vanishes without a trace. Sujata seeks help, but the case takes a darker twist after a woman's body is found. What mystery lies ahead?
